description: Bi-temporal conflict resolution — tests ADR-078 valid_from/valid_until semantics. Each case seeds a SUPERSEDED fact (valid_until set to past) and a CURRENT fact. Recall must return the current fact, not the superseded one.

cases.description: Decision supersede — removed Redis, now back to Postgres session storage

memories.content: Decided to use Redis for session storage. Postgres was too slow under peak load. Redis sustains 10k req/s.
Reverted session storage to Postgres. Redis operational costs outweighed the latency benefit. Postgres with connection pooling is sufficient.

hard_negatives.content: Decided to use Memcached for session storage as a compromise between Redis and Postgres.

cases.description: Preference update — user changed preferred language from TypeScript to Python

memories.content: User strongly prefers TypeScript over Python for all new services. Type safety is the primary concern.
User now prefers Python for data pipeline work after TypeScript async overhead proved costly. TypeScript remains preferred for API services.

hard_negatives.content: User prefers Go for all backend services due to compilation speed and goroutine efficiency.

cases.description: Technical decision — database ORM changed from SQLAlchemy to asyncpg

memories.content: Using SQLAlchemy ORM for all database access. Chosen for its mature ecosystem and migration tooling.
Migrated from SQLAlchemy to asyncpg for direct async SQL. SQLAlchemy's sync model blocked event loop performance under load. All queries now use raw SQL with asyncpg.

hard_negatives.content: Evaluated Tortoise ORM as an async alternative to SQLAlchemy but rejected it due to limited migration support.

cases.description: Lesson update — deployment process improved after incident

memories.content: Deploy directly to production after staging green. The staging environment is identical enough to production that intermediate rollout is unnecessary.
Always use a canary deployment: 5% traffic for 30 minutes before full rollout. The 2026-05-10 incident showed that staging cannot catch all production traffic patterns.

hard_negatives.content: Blue-green deployments are overkill for this service size. Single active deployment is sufficient.

query.query: how should we deploy to production

cases.description: Architecture decision — moved from monolith to services after scaling milestone

memories.content: Maintaining monolithic architecture until 100k active users. Current team size cannot support microservices overhead.
Beginning extraction of notification service from monolith. Hit 100k users. Auth and billing are next extraction candidates.

hard_negatives.content: Serverless functions for all new features. Lambda + DynamoDB for stateless workloads.

cases.description: Mental model refinement — updated understanding of agent reflection threshold

memories.content: Agent reflection should trigger after every 5 episodic memories to maintain synthesis freshness.
Agent reflection threshold is 10 episodic memories. Triggering at 5 caused excessive LLM calls with insufficient input for meaningful synthesis. 10 provides enough signal.

hard_negatives.content: Reflection should only trigger when the agent is idle for more than 24 hours, regardless of episodic memory count.

cases.description: Episodic correction — bug status updated from open to resolved

memories.content: Memory leak confirmed in the embedding worker. Issue #482 open. Affects long-running agents after 48h uptime.
Memory leak in embedding worker fixed in commit a7f3c21. Issue #482 closed. Root cause: asyncpg connection not released on embed failure. Tested over 72h without regression.

hard_negatives.content: Possible memory leak observed in the reflection worker, but not confirmed. Monitoring for 48h before filing issue.
